findings.title: Payment Terms
findings.deviation: Payment within 60 days of receipt of invoice (45 days maximum) is not acceptable according to the playbook. The maximum acceptable payment term is 45 days.
findings.impact: This could lead to cash flow issues for AtliQ if the client delays payments beyond 45 days.
findings.clauseRef: 6.3 Payment to Partner. Datavane shall pay Partner's share of Joint Deal Revenue within sixty (60) days after the end of the calendar quarter in which Datavane receives payment from the relevant Datavane Account.
findings.quote: Datavane shall pay Partner's share of Joint Deal Revenue within sixty (60) days after the end of the calendar quarter in which Datavane receives payment from the relevant Datavane Account.
findings.counterPosition: Payment within 30 days of receipt of invoice (45 days maximum); no pay-when-paid; set-off limited to undisputed amounts under this agreement.
findings.linkedQuote: Payment within 30 days of receipt of invoice (45 days maximum); no pay-when-paid; set-off limited to undisputed amounts under this agreement.

findings.title: Limitation of Liability
findings.deviation: AtliQ's liability is capped at USD 10,000, which is unlimited according to the playbook. The playbook mandates a mutual cap of 1× fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim.
findings.impact: AtliQ may be held liable for more than the agreed cap, leading to potential financial losses.
findings.clauseRef: 12.2 Cap on Datavane Liability. DATAVANE'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT, INCLUDING UNDER SECTION 11.2, SHALL NOT EXCEED TEN THOUSAND UNITED STATES DOLLARS (USD 10,000).
findings.quote: DATAVANE'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT, INCLUDING UNDER SECTION 11.2, SHALL NOT EXCEED TEN THOUSAND UNITED STATES DOLLARS (USD 10,000).
findings.counterPosition: Mutual cap of 1× fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim; carve-outs limited to fraud, wilful misconduct and breach of confidentiality; data-protection liability under a separate super-cap (e.g. 2× fees).
findings.linkedQuote: Mutual cap of 1× fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim; carve-outs limited to fraud, wilful misconduct and breach of confidentiality; data-protection liability under a separate super-cap (e.g. 2× fees).

findings.title: Indemnity
findings.deviation: Partner indemnifies Datavane for Partner Services, which is not in line with the playbook. The playbook requires each party to indemnify the other for its own breach or negligence, not the other party's.
findings.impact: AtliQ may be held liable for Partner's negligence, which is not covered under the indemnity clause.
findings.clauseRef: 11.1 By Partner. Partner shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Datavane, its Affiliates and their respective directors, officers, employees and agents from and against any and all Losses arising out of or relating to (a) the Partner Services; (b) any breach of this Agreement by Partner or its Affiliates; (c) any representation made by Partner regarding the Platform; (d) any claim by a Datavane Account relating to Partner Services or any Joint Deal; or (e) any act or omission of Partner's personnel or subcontractors.
findings.quote: Partner shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Datavane, its Affiliates and their respective directors, officers, employees and agents from and against any and all Losses arising out of or relating to (a) the Partner Services; (b) any breach of this Agreement by Partner or its Affiliates; (c) any representation made by Partner regarding the Platform; (d) any claim by a Datavane Account relating to Partner Services or any Joint Deal; or (e) any act or omission of Partner's personnel or subcontractors.
findings.counterPosition: Each party indemnifies the other for third-party claims caused by its own breach or negligence; no indemnity for losses caused by the indemnified party's own negligence; indemnities subject to the liability cap (IP infringement excepted).
findings.linkedQuote: Each party indemnifies the other for third-party claims caused by its own breach or negligence; no indemnity for losses caused by the indemnified party's own negligence; indemnities subject to the liability cap (IP infringement excepted).
